notes.title: Blades & Battles in the Made in Brazil Sale 🛡️
notes.content:
⚔️🔥 Greetings, warriors! 🔥⚔️

We couldn’t think of a better way to begin our journey: From today until [b]March 4th[/b], Blades & Battles is part of [b]the Made in Brazil Sale[/b]! A event featuring incredible Brazilian games!

[b]Blades & Battles [/b]is a fantasy Beat 'Em Up that takes players to the heart of King Arthur’s legendary world during his barbarian youth 🛡️


See you on the battlefield… this journey is just beginning!
